_tax_comment: Story 13.1: the tax cycle (GameManager.tax_config; every event on EconomyBus). tax_due_day: the first due day of a run. Then every tax_interval_days. The amount: tax_base_amount + tax_per_adventurer x the roster's size. A morning that can't pay starts the grace: the guild falls (bankruptcy) on the morning tax_grace_period_days is reached, counting the due morning as the first. tax_warning_days: the days before the due day that warn (a banner and a log line). Today's numbers; Story 14.6's demo profile may override them. A bad value falls back to today's with a warning.
_death_chance_comment: Story 14.6 (K-8, Raphael 2026-11-01: deaths likelier in the demo): death_chance_multiplier scales a failed contract's death chance (GameManager.calculate_death_chance: the level's base x the danger step, then the beer-shortage penalty; the 80% cap stays). 1 is the full game's. profiles.demo doubles it, so most demo sessions see a death before the King's messenger (the 14.6 pacing model). A number >= 0; a bad value is 1 with a warning.
_soft_lock_comment: Story 13.4 and its review (P2, no way back): the guild falls (soft_lock) on a morning when no adventurer is alive, no applicant can be hired with the gold (GameManager.hire_block_reason) and the bar can't earn: no beer to sell and less gold than beer_pint_price (the bar's one-pint price). With the whole deck dealt, no one alive and no one hireable is the end too (Story 4.2). soft_lock_gold_below is the low-gold line: no one to send and less gold than it logs a warning, not a fall.

day_clock._comment: Story 3.7 (decision log K-14..K-19): the day clock. Hours run start_hour..end_hour (6..26: 26 is 2:00 the next morning). phases: each phase's start hour, in order (TavernLighting's names; it must start at start_hour, rise strictly and end before end_hour; dawn is the Departure's, never on the clock). sleep_from_hour: the bedroom's Sleep from this hour (earlier: 'too early', K-16). closing_hour: the guests not yet served go home. tired_warning_hour: one banner. display_step_minutes: the HUD's step. wake_spot: where a nod-off outside wakes the player in the hall (MainTavern coordinates, by the bedroom door; CL-16). The day's length is day_clock_seconds_per_hour (per profile). A bad value: its default, with a warning.

_day_clock_seconds_per_hour_comment: Story 3.7: real seconds per in-game hour. The full game's 30 (a 10-minute day, K-18); profiles.demo's 18 (a 6-minute day, K-14). A number in (0, 600].

patron_phase_rates._comment: Story 3.7 (CL-6): the patrons by the hour. Per phase: spawn_interval (real seconds between the spawner's tries; 0 = none) and max_patrons (at once in the hall, 0..12). day is today's spawner exactly (20 s, 5). late_night 0/0 is last call (23:00); the unserved go home at day_clock.closing_hour. Prices are unchanged (K-17); a missing or bad row is the spawner's own values with a warning.

_drink_labels_comment: Stories 4.2/4.3: how the hire panel and the roster say a drink preference (one label per id in drink_preferences; an id with no label reads 'Drinks <id>'). DRAFT text.

demo_party_missions._comment: Story 6.5 (DD-7): party (group) missions start at Tier 2, which the first tax (Day 30) unlocks, so a demo session never meets one. In the demo profile only, from from_day each mission refresh carries at least per_refresh party missions, drawn from the party templates of tier <= max_tier. per_refresh 0 turns it off (the old behaviour). The full profile ignores this.

_dispatch_strong_fit_comment: Story 6.5 (DD-6): on the World Map scroll, READY adventurers whose chance on the mission is among the best N (N = the party size) and at least dispatch_strong_fit_min_chance percent are marked Good fit. A suggestion only; nothing is pre-filled.

den_fa_state_tiers._comment: Story 10.3: the reputation tier (a reputation_tiers label) at which Den Fa moves to his Mid and Late states. Forward only. An unknown label, or late at or below mid, falls back to Known / Trusted with a warning.

anime_look_presets._comment: The anime cast's look (scripts/game/anime_look.gd). anime_look_preset: 'approved' (the approved anime test's look, set in code: toon StandardMaterial3D, TOON_BAND 0.12, anime_outline.tres grow 0.011 ink (0.17, 0.09, 0.12)) or one of these shader presets (assets/characters/materials/anime_toon.gdshader). An unknown name falls back to approved with a warning; a missing or bad number takes anime_look.gd's SHADER_DEFAULTS (the approved look's). band_threshold: N.L at the light band's edge (0 = approved); band_softness: half the edge's width (0.12 = approved); lit_gain: x every light on the lit side; shadow_level: x the ambient on the unlit side (0..1); shadow_fill: x every light on the unlit side, a toon shadow colour (0..1; 0 = approved, ambient only); shadow_tint: the unlit side's colour cast (RGB, each 0.05..1); shadow_desaturate: the unlit side's albedo towards grey (0..1); outline_grow / outline_ink: the ink hull's width (m) and colour.

_edge_pass_comment: edge_pass: the screen's edge/ink pass (assets/shaders/edge_detection.gdshader on the camera's quad) in MainTavern and ExteriorWorld; false hides it at load (Raphael, 2026-10-04). Dev key 4 in the hall toggles it live.
_hall_look_comment: hall_look: the hall look, pass 1 (scripts/game/hall_look.gd; brainstorm 2026-11-03): the shell's world-space floor and wall materials, soot-dark timber, placeholder lanterns on chains and faded banners, put on by TavernLighting at load; false keeps the kit's own look. Dev key 5 in the hall toggles it live.
_exterior_look_comment: exterior_look: the exterior look (scripts/world/exterior_look.gd; brainstorm 2026-11-03, Raphael's Octopath shot): grass, cobble and water materials, the village windows lit by phase, the light and the air per day phase (haze, valley mist, glow), placeholder braziers, lamp posts and falling leaves; false keeps the scene's own look. Dev keys outside: 5 on/off, 2 the next phase.

tavern_light_moods._comment: The hall's base light (scripts/game/tavern_lighting.gd, Story 25.23). tavern_light_mood: 'today' (the scene as saved: MainTavern's lights snapshotted at load; it can't be defined here) or one of these presets. An unknown name falls back to today with a warning; a missing or bad value takes today's, with a warning. ambient_color [r,g,b] 0..1 x ambient_energy 0..4: the explicit ambient (today renders the project's clear colour, 0.3 grey); sun_lights_hall: false = the one DirectionalLight only inks (its direction, colour and energy never change: the edge pass multiplies by it); fill_energy 0..8 (TavernLight, the cold NE fill; today 2.0), bar_energy / desk_energy 0..8 (BarLight, the desk's DeskLight; today 1.5); bar_pool_energy 0..8 (BarPool, a warm light over the round bar with no lamp of its own: the bar shows no flame; today 0 = off; the phase's candle_scale scales it); hearth_scale 0.05..4 (x the fire's light, hearth.gd light_scale); candle_scale 0..4 (x each tavern_candle light's base_energy: the board sconces, the torches, the thin candle; today 0 = off); window_color [r,g,b] / window_energy 0..8 (the tavern_window spot lights outside the north and west windows; today 0 = off); shadow_lights: which lights cast (hearth, bar, desk, fill; candles and windows never do); omni_shadow_mode: dual_paraboloid (2 views) or cube (6 views); pillar_glow 0.6..2.0 (the Hourglass Pillar's emission); exposure 0.25..4 (tonemap_exposure, Linear tonemap kept).

history._comment: The hall look, pass 1 (brainstorm 2026-11-03, 'this place has history'): islands of warm light (the hearth up and shadowed, the lanterns, torches and candles) in a dim cool hall.

tavern_light_phases._comment: The day phases on top of the mood (Story 25.23). Each scale multiplies the mood's value: ambient_scale (the ambient energy), candle_scale, hearth_scale, fill_scale (TavernLight), pillar_glow_scale (keep mood x phase glow within 0.6..2.0), window_energy (x the mood's window_energy); window_color [r,g,b] replaces the mood's (absent = the mood's). 'day' is the identity (every scale 1, no window colour): the picked mood is what play shows. A phase change blends every number over tavern_light_blend_seconds; the moods switch at once. Sent by GameBus.day_phase_changed: evening (the bedroom opens), late_night (sleep; 'reveal' is an alias), morning (the new day), day (the briefing ends, or tavern_light_morning_hold_seconds after a morning with no briefing). dusk and dawn have no trigger yet (the dev keys reach them: F7).

_demo_start_staff_comment: Story 25.13 (K9), Story 14.6 (K-7, Raphael 2026-11-01): the staff roles hired from the first morning, read only in the demo profile (GameManager.staff_hired_by_profile). Empty since K-7: in the demo the Bartender and the Quest Dealer are hired like in the full game, once staff_unlock allows it.
_staff_unlock_comment: Story 14.6 (K-7): when a staff role can be hired. {rule: tier}: at its data/characters/staff.json unlock_tier (the full game, Story 16.1). {rule: gold_peak, gold_peak: N}: every role once the run's gold peak (GameManager.gold_peak, the most gold the guild has held) reaches N, for the rest of the run. GameManager.staff_unlock_rule() reads it and staff_ctx() hands it, with the peak, to staff_hire_block_for. A bad value falls back to tier with a warning.

staff_wages._comment: Epic 16: the staff's pay (GameManager reads it, so Story 14.6's demo profile can override it). daily_wage: gold a day per role id of data/characters/staff.json; a staff record takes it when it is created (New Game, a save without staff) and the first day's wage is paid at hire (Story 16.1). Placeholder numbers (GDD: staff ~2-5 g/day). A missing or bad wage is 1 with a warning. Story 16.5: wages are paid each morning right after the adventurers'; a wage that can't be paid puts that member on strike (no work, the wage owed until the player pays it back); missed_days_to_leave unpaid mornings in a row and they leave (a whole number >= 1; bad or missing: 3).

staff_automation._comment: Epic 16: how the hall's staff work by themselves (their LimboAI brains, scripts/game/staff_ai.gd). Story 16.3: the Bartender serves a patron on one of the round bar's stools once they have waited bartender_react_seconds (the player's E can still serve them first; table patrons stay the player's). Story 16.4: each morning the Quest Dealer waits desk_round_delay_seconds after the reports, then sends up to desk_auto_per_day READY Minor Arcana on open solo contracts of tier <= desk_auto_max_tier, only at a success estimate of desk_auto_min_chance percent or better (Major Arcana and party contracts stay the player's); 0 a day turns her round off. A bad or missing value falls back with a warning.

_disturbance_comment: Story 14.4: the tavern disturbances (data/disturbances/disturbances.json). Each morning: below disturbance_reputation_below reputation, at least disturbance_cooldown_days after the last one, a disturbance_daily_chance roll (0..1) queues one for the day. disturbance_schedule: [{day, type, truth?}] forces one on a day whatever the rest says. One at a time. A bad value falls back with a warning.
_reputation_gains_comment: Story 14.6 (DP-3): how far each source moves the guild's reputation (GameManager.rep_gain; adjust_reputation carries the reason on GuildBus.reputation_adjusted). The top level is the full game's: today's numbers (a group contract's success and a satisfied patron give 0, as before). profiles.demo makes them faster. A whole number; a bad value falls back to today's with a warning.

demo_ending._comment: Story 10.7 (sprint-change-proposal-2026-10-31.md K-2, K-3): the demo's ending, the King's messenger. On the morning after reputation >= min_reputation AND at least min_taxes_paid taxes are paid, he walks into the tavern. Only when enabled AND the profile is demo (DataManager.is_demo()): the full game never runs it. Story 14.6 adds the keys (off here); profiles.demo turns them on. Whole numbers: min_reputation >= 0, min_taxes_paid >= 1.

_bard_comment: Epic 9 (Story 9.1): the travelling Bard. Each morning (after the disturbance roll; one visitor a day, K-20: none on the King's messenger's day or a disturbance's day) a visit is queued when the guild's reputation tier is at least bard_min_tier (a tier label), at least bard_cooldown_days have passed since the last visit and a bard_daily_chance roll (0..1) comes up. bard_schedule: [{day, hook?, hour?}] forces a visit on a day (day >= 2) whatever the rest says; hook: a quest hook if he plays (Story 9.4). He comes to the door at an hour rolled in bard_arrival_hours [from, to] (the day clock's hours, inside the hall's open hours 9-23), once the hall is clear and bard_arrival_delay_seconds (real) have passed, and waits bard_wait_hours of clock time before he moves on. Story 9.2: let in, he plays until the clock's closing hour and keeps bard_tip_share (0..1) of every patron's payment meanwhile; the next morning bard_rumours_per_performance (1..5) of his rumours reach Latest News. DRAFT numbers; a bad value falls back with a warning.

profiles._comment: Story 14.6 (DP-1): per-profile values. DataManager.get_config(key) returns profiles.<profile>.<key> when the active profile's block has the key, else the top-level value: the top level is the full game. A block replaces a key's whole value (lists and objects are never merged). Every key in a block also exists at the top level; profile and profiles are never in a block. Keys tools read straight from this file can't be overridden: anime_look_preset(s), edge_pass, tavern_light_*, autosave_interval_seconds. The demo's other switches are top-level demo-only keys: demo_start_staff, demo_party_missions.

demo._comment: The Kickstarter demo. DRAFT numbers: Phase F playtests retune them. Pacing (14.6 DP-2, DP-4): faster tiers and gains and a satisfied patron's +1, so a typical ~30-minute session is Known on Day 2, Trusted on Day 4 and Respected about Day 6. The arc (14.6 DP-12; sprint-change-proposal-2026-10-31.md K-1..K-6; Raphael 2026-11-01 K-7..K-9): 40 gold and 20 beer to start, a 20-gold tax every 3 days from Day 3 (warned 2 days and 1 day before), the King's messenger (Story 10.7) once reputation reaches 32 after 2 taxes, the staff hireable once the guild has held 150 gold (K-7, amended 2026-11-01), and deaths twice as likely. Disturbances (14.4): a real thief on Day 2, then a 40% chance a morning (2 days apart) while below Respected. The Bard (Epic 9): a sure visit on Day 3 (with a quest hook if he plays), then a 40% chance a morning, 2 days apart.
